title: GREAT HIGHLIGHT TO TRIP
text: Great trip!!!!!! Highly recommend!!!! good tour guide, and great to learn more about Jewish history. Small group, pretty streets, gorgeous atmosphere.
author: francescagJ7270EU

title: EASY WALK THROUGH HISTORY AND BEAUTY OF SEVILLA’S JEWISH QUARTER
text: Sara was an excellent guide with great knowledge of Jewish history in Sevilla.  The references to Jews contributions to Spain throughout the centuries, the references to opera, and the gardens were amazing!
author: LoriDLP

title: Sevilla morning
text: Very nice morning walk through the historic Santa Cruz neighborhood with our guide, who was very knowledgeable.
author: jhkauper

title: Morning tour of Santa Cruz
text:
A pleasant stroll around Santa Cruz with our guide. We were lucky to be the only participants - an unexpected personal tour for our family !
Our guide was excellent and had a good sense of humour !
author: Amanda_L

title: Great tour with a well prepared guide
text: Great guide, very knowledgeable about the history of Seville. He was super personable and made the visit fun and interesting. I'd gladly go on another tour with a guide like him.
author: Embarcadero1

title: Very interesting area not to miss
text: Very good guide who was very knowledgeable and gave us background into the history of the area. Would definitely recommend this tour as it’s an area of the city we would have missed if we hadn’t booked the tour.
author: Janice P

title: Santa Cruz Ancient Jewish Ghetto
text: Learning the history of the Jewish ghetto in Seville was very interesting. Not much is left from so long ago, just little markers along the way. Very interesting.
author: Nancy_V

title: Incredible Tour - Highly Recommend
text: We loved this tour of the Jewish Quarter. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and honest about this piece of history in Sevilla. I would highly recommend this to anyone looking to get a deeper, different perspective of Sevilla.
author: G4350UVchristinak

title: Learning interesting...
text:
Learned interesting history of the quarter.
Tour guide was informed and welcoming. She found streets to visit outside of the sun. Answered all questions.
author: Robert_D

title: Fun and educational
text: Maria was very knowledgeable and made it fun and informative. Excellent tour guide and interesting place.
author: Stephen_B
